caption:
A morning dua for a steady heart after guidance.

This dua asks Allah for two things: a heart that stays firm on guidance, and His mercy. Make it part of your morning before the day pulls you in every direction.

Surah Aal-i-Imraan 3:8

Save it and say it once before you leave home today.

#quran #morningdua #steadfastheart #quranicdua
alt_text: “Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us Your mercy; for You are the Munificent Bestower (Surah Aal-i-Imraan 3:8)
